about_the_game:
Game Overview

Meet the tiny idle RPG that fits right into your taskbar!

Key Features

1. A Tiny Idle RPG That Fits in Your Taskbar

- 'TBH: Task Bar Hero' takes up minimal screen space, making it an RPG you can keep running without worry.

Its lightweight design means it won't consume much system resources either!"

2. Items Generate Just by Keeping It Running. Trade Them on the Steam Market!

- Simply keep it running and watch your inventory fill up with items to power up your heroes.

If you get a great item, try trading it on the Steam Community Market.

3. Create Your Own Build with Various Classes, Skills, and Items!

- With 6 unique character classes, countless items and skills, and 3-member party combinations, you can create your own creative builds.

You can even add various stats to items through the Cube!

(*Note: When trading items on the Steam Market, all stats granted through the Cube will be removed)

4. Won't Disrupt Your Important Work!

- With its non-intrusive design, it won't interfere with your important tasks.

With fully automated gameplay, your characters continue their adventures automatically. No clicking or repetitive actions required!

Simply step in when you want to collect rewards or upgrade your characters.

Important Notice

  • All demo version data and tradeable items will be deleted after the full version release

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Experience a tiny idle RPG! Join these small but mighty heroes on a casual adventure from a corner of your monitor.
